static_65536_feasibility: 1024 full candidates need 64 heights; actual packing/rounds must still finish every signed row within [1,257), otherwise fail without extending or renewing signed intents
input_identity: one in-memory signed corpus replayed byte-identically across CPU/GPU/CPU
signature_generation_timing: all workload signing excluded before first submission
environment_scope: explicit inherited settings; null means unset, not an effective AOEM default or device identity

unmeasured.scope: logical signed-input and application-object sizes are not physical wire traffic or retransmission counts

apfl_size_measurement_scope: untimed reconstruction from the exact submitted signed corpus; canonical expanded bytes and lossless APFL bytes preserve every signature; application_object_bytes also includes original native envelope, neither is physical/retransmitted UDP traffic
phase: cold restart all receipts balances and authorizations

latency_us.definition: first native wire-frame submission attempt to slowest of four receipt-query observations; includes initial execution/consensus wait and bounded observer; not an internal finality timestamp

timing: same native load drive: first SDK submission attempt through every unique four-node receipt-query observation; startup/keygen/signing/structure preparation/untimed economics/cold recovery excluded
